contexts.text: Those in the province of the spleen are almost directly above the head; but their operation falls (towards the left).
The inhabitants and Spirits (of the First Earth) relate to something in the spleen; which was confirmed by their influx into the spleen while speaking to me.
They who are in the spleen, etc. are in the purification of good and truth.
Man knows not how... the pancreas and spleen purify.
On the province of the spleen, etc.
The spleen is also such; for it receives the filthy blood, with which the pure blood has also been intermingled, which serves in place of a menstruum...
